dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project is to document and understand the historical evolution of adult and post-secondary education in Inuit Nunangat. To date, we have developed an inventory and analysis of all the adult and post-secondary education programs offered to Inuit (in northern and southern Canada), starting from the late 1950s until present day. We have also traced the history of the idea of, and the debate surrounding, the establishment of a university in Northern Canada.
